caption:
Capacity: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.

Allah tells us that He does not burden a soul more than what it can bear, and that He has a Record of deeds that tells the truth, and none will be wronged. Begin this Monday doing your best with what you have been given.

Surah Al-Muminoon 23:62

Take on one task today that you have been putting off.

#quran #notburdened #mondaymotivation #muslimreminder
